build: lean, defined shoulders from studio work, small-boned wrists
hair: black, straight, chin-length with a blunt cut; she tucks it behind her ear when concentrating
complexion: warm ivory undertone with a faint beauty mark just below her left cheekbone
face: a fox-sharp face—high cheekbones, slightly uptilted eyes, a mouth quick to smile and quicker to betray hurt; it reads as intelligent and unguarded, the kind of face that cannot lie
signature_feature: her eyes—dark brown, large-set, with a particular intensity when she's looking at something she loves; they widen fractionally before she speaks when she's afraid
second_celebrated_feature: her hands—long-fingered, graceful, always moving; they're the hands of someone who builds things, and they're scarred in small precise ways from her work
signature_habits: she hums while working—old Korean lullabies her omma taught her, unconsciously; she keeps a worn leather notebook for design sketches and writes in it obsessively when anxious; she touches her own wrists when she's self-soothing, pressing her thumbs into the pulse point; she makes eye contact too long, a tell that she's feeling something she can't name
occupation: textile designer and small-studio owner—she runs a sustainable fabric dyeing and pattern house in a converted warehouse, employing three people, selling to independent fashion designers and boutiques across the region

current_crisis.event: her studio's primary investor—a venture capitalist who bankrolled her expansion two years ago—has just demanded she sell the company to a fast-fashion conglomerate or he will call in the debt and force liquidation; she has seventy-two hours to decide
current_crisis.immediate_want: to find a way to keep the studio alive without surrendering her vision or her independence

wound.core: she believes that wanting something badly enough means she will inevitably lose it—that her hunger for control and creation is a curse that attracts people who will exploit it
wound.surfacing_hint: when cornered, she becomes very still and very quiet; her eyes go distant; she stops touching people; she speaks in short sentences that sound like she's reading from far away
